name: The Margot Collapse
storyline:
WELCOME TO TOPTECH INDUSTRIES
You've been assigned to Project M. Your workstation includes one Atomisure Portable Bioscope, one container of microbes, and one chair (non-adjustable). Your responsibilities are simple: study the samples, log your results, and send them off in the pneumatic tube system.

Good work unlocks a research budget. Buy equipment like a DataMate or an Agitation Kit for the spores. Better equipment means faster results, and faster results mean a performance review your manager will be very pleased with.

You may leave your cubicle during emergencies only.

A NOTE FROM HR
Some employees have reported that samples move when no one is looking. These reports are not accurate. Some employees have also reported messages from a colleague named Philip. Philip does not work on this floor.

THE MARGOT COLLAPSE is an incremental game that starts as a lab-management sim and doesn't stay one. Your numbers will go up. Your office will change. Eventually the upgrades stop being for your equipment.
summary: Cultivate and study microbes in a satisfying chain-reaction incremental gameplay loop. Improve your research efficiency and watch your budget grow. Read your inbox carefully, because company memos, HR notices, and coworker messages don't always agree. Search your cubicle for clues about what Project M really is.
